channel.title: Fort Worth Report - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Fort Worth Report (fortworthreport.org)

item.title: TXU North Main plant off market. TCC won’t oppose historic protection
item.description: Tarrant County College says the one bid for the power plant, which is on the future Panther Island, was less than appraised value.

item.title: Thousands gather in DC for Fort Worth monks’ Walk for Peace arrival
item.description: A group of Fort Worth monks walking 2,300 miles for peace made it to the nation’s capital 108 days after leaving their eastside temple.

item.title: Arlington says reports of a gas leak were a false alarm with no natural gas released
item.description: The school district says it is working to reduce the odor of gas entering district buildings.

item.title: Horse bronzes transform Don Artemio restaurant into mini gallery
item.description: Mexican artist Alejandro Fuentes Gil’s sculptures are on display at the Fort Worth restaurant through March.

item.title: Tarrant County seeks state grant to support ICE partnership
item.description: The Tarrant County jail has 388 inmates with a federal immigration hold, officials said Tuesday.

item.title: Northwest ISD launches limited open enrollment as some schools brace for student loss
item.description: About 100 transfer students could join the pilot program as officials try to stabilize campuses in neighborhoods with slowing growth.

item.title: As Walk for Peace reaches DC, Buddhist monks share interfaith message with thousands
item.description: WASHINGTON (RNS) — Dominga Hobbs, who lives in Colombia and lost her husband in the past year, said, ‘I’m here for me, for my family, and to honor the monks for this extraordinary effort. My husband believed in peace, and I feel that he’s here with us.’

item.title: New rules limit public speaking, discussion topics at Tarrant County Commissioners Court
item.description: Briefings about deaths in Tarrant County’s jail won’t be allowed during the commissioners’ public meetings.

item.title: Arlington council passes revised anti-discrimination ordinance, resolution against hate
item.description: The ordinance is a revised version of one passed in 2021, which was struck down in September after a federal grant funding scare.

item.title: Fort Worth voters asked to give city manager more autonomy, increase council’s pay in May election
item.description: The city charter election includes nine amendments on the ballot, including one added without a public discussion relating to city expenses.
